summary: Frontend rich text (TipTap) editor tested end-to-end on Meetings page and mounting verified on Dashboard/Reunion/FamilyBusiness/Payments/Documents. All toolbar functions (Bold, Italic, H2, H3, Bullet, Ordered, Link with window.prompt dialog) work; content persists to backend as HTML, view mode renders sanitized HTML via DOMPurify with target=_blank on links, and hard-reload retains formatting. Backward compatibility confirmed (existing plain text like 'Annual review and budget approval' still displays). EText single-line fields still render as plain <input>. No console errors from TipTap.
critical_code_review_comments:
RichText.jsx: isEmptyHtml regex `(?!\s*$)` is a bit convoluted for detecting non-empty
; consider simpler logic. Not a bug.
Editable.jsx EArea passes `rows={2}` from callers but RichTextEditor ignores it — either accept and apply as CSS min-height or remove the prop from call sites for clarity.
seed_data_creation: Added and removed a description section on Meetings upcoming[0] for testing; final state saved with section removed. The tested formatted content (Hello World with bold/italic/list/heading/link) was saved into meetings.upcoming[0].sections[0].value before cleanup removed that section.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TipTap RichTextEditor works via contenteditable div with data-testid=edit-<path>. Toolbar buttons use suffixes -h2 -h3 -bold -italic -bullet -ordered -link. Link button opens window.prompt: register dialog handler with page.once('dialog', ...) before click. View mode uses testid content-<path> rendering rich-content div. Backend persists HTML strings in loose content dict.
